Hello! My name is David Estrine and I am a Software Engineering student from the University of Waterloo and I made TalkingML to share my journey as I become "cracked" at Machine Learning.

![me enjoying life in first year](assets/me-c58c04cb.png){fig-alt="me enjoying life in first year" width="25%" fig-align="center"}
